original_test_intent: Prove that every required GPU-memory temperature channel for the installed AMD or NVIDIA population appears with the correct identity, description, units and plausible reading in SDR, IPMI sensor output and BMC Web, with in-band/out-of-band parity.
original_method: Resolve the installed GPU vendor and slot population into an authoritative per-GPU memory-sensor matrix, collect complete SDR and sensor inventories through trusted in-band and OOB paths, compare each member and its Web representation with the specification, then inspect preserved logs for anomalies.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the installed GPU-to-sensor and BMC-Web matrix plus expected ranges; an operator verifies Web fields and decides the result. Automation collects and reconciles the read-only IPMI evidence.
required_inputs: SUT, baseboard, BMC/SDR and GPU firmware versions
Installed GPU vendor/model, slot, serial/UUID and zero-/one-based index convention
Required AMD TEMP_UBB_GPU0~7M or NVIDIA TEMP_GB_GPU1~8_M member list
Per-member SDR record/name/description, units, valid range, status and update/staleness limits
In-band and OOB IPMI source equivalence and credential policy
BMC Web label-to-SDR mapping and allowable presentation differences
GPU memory temperature correlation source and idle/environment envelope
Unexpected-log criteria, retention policy and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not pass TEMP_GPU_Memory_0~N as though it were one literal sensor name
Enumerate all required members and report missing, extra, duplicate or misindexed channels individually
Retain complete SDR and sensor-list output; do not use `head -100` as acceptance evidence
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL by default; export and hash baselines
Do not expose the BMC password in process arguments or retained logs
Do not change thresholds, sensor state, firmware, GPU workload or BMC configuration
Stop on invalid/stale/unavailable readings, IPMI path disagreement, unexpected GPU/BMC thermal condition or management instability
agent_execution_scope: Fingerprint GPU population and resolve the applicable vendor naming scheme
Collect complete read-only SDR and sensor inventories via approved in-band and OOB access
Parse every expected channel and compare identity, units, value, status and update freshness
Correlate channel index with GPU slot/UUID and available GPU memory temperature telemetry
Prepare BMC-Web parity rows for operator verification
Collect baseline/post logs without clearing them
Perform no workload, write, reset or verdict action
engineer_actions: Approve the per-populated-GPU sensor membership and index convention
Provide expected records, units, ranges, state and Web mapping
Evaluate missing/mismatched/stale or thermally abnormal channels

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially applicable as a read-only starting point, but `sensor get 'TEMP_GPU_Memory_0~N'` treats a range expression as one SDR name and cannot prove all GPUs. The 100-line fallback, password argument and missing in-band/Web parity violate the source acceptance contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using secret-safe approved in-band and OOB IPMI sessions, capture complete `sdr elist` and `sensor list` output, then select the project-enumerated AMD or NVIDIA GPU-memory sensor names exactly and build a per-member SDR/sensor/Web comparison matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal aggregate Items, AMD GPU0~7M and NVIDIA GPU1~8_M alternatives, IB/OOB/Web views, specification comparison and 3/3-minute estimates are preserved; installed membership and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES GPU POPULATION SENSOR MATRIX AND WEB CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map every installed GPU to its expected memory-temperature SDR, snapshot complete IB/OOB inventories, reconcile values and identities with the vendor-specific index convention, correlate against GPU telemetry, and have the operator confirm each BMC-Web row.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the source's range expression and vendor alternatives explicit per-member checks, fixes invalid/truncated derived commands and preserves logs instead of clearing them.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single matching sensor or first 100 SDR lines cannot satisfy `0~N`; Web presence without SDR/slot correlation also cannot prove correct channel attribution.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readback is non-destructive, but a missing or misindexed GPU-memory channel can hide an overheating device; stale values and different polling intervals must not be mistaken for parity failure.

project_override_considerations: Platforms with fewer than eight GPUs or different approved sensor labels may provide an explicit applicability matrix. Absent slots must be recorded as not installed, not silently omitted, and AMD/NVIDIA alternatives must not be combined unless the SUT actually contains both supported populations.
expected_evidence: Approved vendor-specific required-sensor membership and index mapping
Complete raw in-band and OOB SDR/sensor outputs with exit status and redaction record
Per-member IB/OOB parity and GPU-slot/telemetry correlation
Timestamped BMC-Web screenshot/export and field-level comparison for every member
Baseline/post dmesg/syslog/SEL, GPU thermal and BMC health without unapproved clearing
Missing/extra/duplicate/stale matrix, recovery audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The generic `TEMP_GPU_Memory_0~N` Items and the AMD/NVIDIA-specific procedure are reconcilable as platform-dependent enumeration alternatives. The row is incomplete without the project matrix but does not assert mutually exclusive facts for one selected SUT.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The required operation and three evidence views are explicit. Sensor membership, ranges and Web labels are normal project inputs, so complete read-only collection is executable after confirmation rather than irreducibly blocked.

review_improvement: Converts one invalid aggregate lookup into a vendor-aware per-GPU completeness test, adds GPU-slot attribution and IB/OOB/Web parity, and prevents truncated output or cleared logs from masking missing memory-temperature channels.
independent_technical_reasoning: The tilde expression denotes a family, not an SDR record, and the source itself shows incompatible vendor naming/index bases. Correctness therefore depends on expanding the installed population first. Every expected sensor must be tied to one GPU and checked across both IPMI paths plus Web; otherwise a lone good reading can conceal an absent or swapped channel. Because this is passive telemetry with supplyable limits, approval and mapping—not physical execution—are the remaining gates.
